Steps.1: Connect a banana cable between the positive and negative terminals on CH1 of the power supply source.
Steps.2: Connect the current probe to the oscilloscope.
Steps.3: Connect the current probe power to the oscilloscope USB port.
Steps.4: Switch on the power supply source.
Steps.6: Set different voltages on the CH1 of the power supply source.
Steps.7: Adjust the gain of the current probe to calibrate it, according to the value set in the power supply.
Steps.8: Solder wires to C20 pad (signal 5V) and GND of the hw_DAA.
Steps.9: Connect the hw_DAA to a DAA CS harness.
Steps.10: Set 6.5V and 3A on CH1 of the power supply source.
Steps.11: Connect the power supply to the DAA CS harness power input, using a DC power connector, banana cables, crocodile clips and a switch (according to the attached diagram).
Steps.12: Press the On/Off button to turn on CH1 of the power supply source.
Steps.13: Connect the current probe to the oscilloscope (CH2) according the attached diagram.
Steps.14: Connect an oscilloscope probe (CH1) to the soldered wire at C20 pads.
Steps.15: Configure CH1 (5V signal): set the vertical offset to ~-3V and the vertical grid to 2 V/div.
Steps.16: Configure CH2 (inrush current): set the vertical offset to ~-100mA and the vertical grid to 200 mA/div.
Steps.17: Set the horizontal grid to 5 ms/div and center the horizontal trigger position at the center of the oscilloscope screen.
Steps.18: Set the trigger level to ~4V. Ensure the trigger mode is set to rising edge and the trigger source is set to CH1.
Steps.19: Set CH2 to current unit (A). Press CH2 button -> More -> Unit.
Steps.20: Press the single button in the oscilloscope.
Steps.21: Switch on the switch of the power supply connector.
Steps.22: Using the measure tab, select Vmax at the CH2 (maximum inrush current).
Steps.24: Take the measurement of the inrush current and repeat it several times.
Steps.25: Repeat the measurements with different voltages at the power supply source: 12V, 24V and 36V (using CH1 and CH2 of the power supply source connected in serial).
